versions.subject: OSCD Task 1 - Privilege Escalation
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentUser:
        - 'NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE'
        - 'NT AUTHORITY\LOCAL SERVICE'
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
rundllexception:
    Image: '*\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine: '*DavSetCookie*'
condition: selection and not rundllexception
versions.spl: ParentUser IN ("NT AUTHORITY\\NETWORK SERVICE", "NT AUTHORITY\\LOCAL SERVICE") User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM" NOT (Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine="*DavSetCookie*")
